hero.title: Nihol Project
hero.description:
Since 2016, Nihol 2016 has been one of the leading distributors in the Tajikistan market. We have established a strong distribution network covering all regions of the country. By purchasing products directly from manufacturers, we efficiently and promptly deliver them to our customers across Tajikistan.
Our team consists of 55 qualified employees, including sales agents, supervisors, and couriers.

partners.title: Our Partners
partners.description: Trusted by leading brands in agriculture and sustainability.

our_partners.Hazera: Hazera is a global leader in the vegetable seed industry. Hazera is the 4th largest seed company in the world, and employs over 10,000 people globally.
our_partners.Enza Zaden: Enza Zaden strives to develop innovative, high-quality vegetable varieties that help feed the world. From crisp lettuce and bright sweet peppers to juicy tomatoes, crunchy cucumbers and aromatic onions, the company breeds more than 30 different vegetable crops. Its impact reaches far beyond the greenhouse — its seeds are sown in fields and gardens around the world.
our_partners.Fitó:
It all starts with a seed. But at Fitó we know that a seed is much more than the origin of a crop: it is the first step in generating sustainable wealth throughout the entire agri-food chain.

Every seed we plant is an opportunity to unite people, generations, and regions. It is the link between the farmer and their land, between the gardener and their green space, between a community and its food. That is why, above all, at Fitó, we cultivate relationships.

A seed is what allows us to unite people and connect our origin with our future.
our_partners.Dutch Plantin: Sustainable cocopeat solutions for modern agriculture.
our_partners.Meristem: Enhancing soil and plant health through innovative products.
our_partners.Pipelife: Arılı Plastik, part of the Pipelife Group, produces agricultural twines and piping solutions in Türkiye.
our_partners.HAS Sentetik: A Turkish manufacturer of polypropylene greenhouse twine for supporting crops during cultivation.
our_partners.ICL: Plant nutrition and fertilizer solutions for agriculture, including controlled-release and water-soluble fertilizers.

about.title: About Us
about.story_description: Founded with a vision to revolutionize agriculture, our mission is to bring sustainable solutions to farmers worldwide. Our innovative approach ensures higher yields while preserving natural resources.
about.mission_description: We strive to empower farmers with the latest technology and sustainable practices. Our products are designed to enhance productivity while ensuring environmental safety.
about.goal_description: To become a local market leader by providing our clients with consistent support and high-quality products. Partnering with Nihol 2016 guarantees quality, reliability, and efficiency!
